spiritual_reading.full_translation:
Concerning the forms that receive and contain spiritual things, understand this: when the Divine Love was about to bring into effect a full progression of the three discrete degrees, it sent them down into the lowest degree in ordered sequence, each according to its appointed state, and allowed them to descend into the outermost plane.

Then the Divine gathered those descending degrees out of the outermost plane by investing them with outward modes suited to reception and action, so they could be present there without being harmed and could act upon what was there. It directed their operation into the three ultimate repositories prepared during the ordering of the whole heaven-and-world structure; yet something of that first contact remained in the outermost plane, so that traces of those operations still appear everywhere as fixed signatures within the total arrangement.

What remains from the operation of truth in ultimates is a sharp and resistant quality within the most external knowledges that encompass lower things. What remains from the operation that dealt with falsity is a stubborn and obscuring state at the boundary of enlightenment, where attempted illumination finds no reception because denial continually rises and throws shade over what would otherwise be made clear. What remains from the operation that dealt with disordered love is the recurring eruption, in many outermost states, of heated cravings that break out into open violence, and from this come barren states of life in which no good work proceeds from perception and no living result can be brought forth.

Know, then, that the Divine sent these degrees down into the outermost plane for this purpose: that the impure things already present in the lower levels might be drawn out and lifted toward what had descended, so that the lower levels could be purified. This descent was ordered so that what was corrupt in truth, what was false in understanding, and what was disordered in love within the natural degree might be extracted, raised toward its like, and separated from what could be cleansed.

First, the Divine dealt with truth in its ultimate forms, where it had become waste and poison through domination by higher falsities. It cleared the intermediate levels of that corruption and permitted the falsified truths to descend into the outermost plane. As the falsified truths were brought down from above into the natural, the falsified truths hidden in the natural were stirred and rose up toward what had descended, so that the truths in ultimates could be purged of the dark contamination mixed into them. Then the Divine expelled that contamination and fixed it as a general enclosing boundary of merely external knowing around the whole outer domain, serving as a defensive limit and as a surface upon which lower reasoning can move.

After this it dealt with falsity itself. It cleared the intermediate levels and removed from them the oppressive obscurity by which they were burdened, and allowed that obscurity to descend into the natural plane. As those levels were purified, so the lower levels were purified: the falsity in the natural was drawn up toward the falsity that had been let down. The Divine expelled them both and confined them together into a fixed state of denial set beneath and apart from what can still serve as an enclosing boundary of external knowing.

Then it dealt with disordered love. It permitted the burning impulse to descend into the natural plane, and at that same time the heated craving shut up in the lowest level was drawn out and rose toward its own kind; disordered love was added to disordered love. Afterward the Divine expelled it and cast it into the most external hell, prepared as a place outside the ordered form of the universe for such loves to dwell in separation.

In the same way that the Divine purified the intermediate levels as a region fit for the orderly movement of illuminating truths, so it purified the lower levels and swept out from them corrupted truth, falsity, and disordered love. It purified them with a view to the ascent of these three operative powers in their orderly forms, so that they may rise before the one who admits and regulates influx and pass through the lower levels in right order.

paragraph_translations.translation: Concerning the containing forms, understand this: when the Divine Love was about to bring into effect a full progression of the three discrete degrees, it sent that full triad down into the lowest degree in ordered sequence, each according to its appointed state, and allowed it to descend into the outermost plane.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES the opening by stating the ordered descent of the three degrees into ultimates.

paragraph_translations.translation: Then the Divine gathered those descending degrees out of the outermost plane by investing them with outward modes suited to reception and action, so they could be present there without injury and could operate there. It directed their operation into three ultimate repositories prepared during the ordering of the whole heaven-and-world structure; yet something from that first contact remained in the outermost plane, so that fixed traces of those operations can still be discerned throughout the whole arrangement.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by describing how the degrees are clothed for operation and then confined, leaving residual signatures.
paragraph_translations.notes: The sequence of gathering, investing, and confining is clear, but the exact nuance of the ‘three garments’ compresses multiple functions (protection, accommodation, and mode of operation).

paragraph_translations.translation: What remains from the operation of truth in ultimates is a sharp and resistant quality within the most external knowledges that encompass lower things, a boundary-condition that can preserve truths there yet can also make them harsh when separated from good.
paragraph_translations.connection: SHIFTS into specific residual effects left in ultimates after the purifying operation.

paragraph_translations.translation: What remains from the operation that dealt with falsity is a stubborn and obscuring state at the boundary of enlightenment: when wisdom seeks to illumine the general mind, no genuine understanding appears there, because denial continually surges forth and casts obscurity over what would otherwise be made clear.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES the list of residues, moving from corrupted truth to active obscurity.
paragraph_translations.notes: The ‘boundary of enlightenment’ is inferred from the function of the described region; the text’s directional imagery is absorbed into a threshold-state.

paragraph_translations.translation: What remains from the operation that dealt with disordered love is the presence, in many outermost states, of eruptions of heated craving and anger that break out and become manifest. From this also come barren states of life in which no good work proceeds from perception and no living result can be brought forth, because the outermost has been joined to a consuming love that destroys the capacity to produce use.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES by giving the third residual effect, now in the will’s disorder and its barren outcomes.
paragraph_translations.notes: The extended catalogue of barren conditions reads as cumulative reinforcement; some phrases appear textually damaged, but the spiritual drift toward sterility of use is consistent.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: The chapter holds together strongly as a single process: ordered descent into ultimates, attraction of like impurities, separation, confinement, and the resulting purification for orderly ascent. It is most coherent where it repeats the three-cycle pattern for truth, falsity, and disordered love. It stumbles only where the source text has damaged or over-extended lists; these sections still resolve into a consistent teaching about sterility of use and residual boundary-effects in externals.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential setup: three “vessels” are taught as functional mechanisms in a purification process (descent → extraction). No jurisdictional cataloging, no named administrators. The spiritual reading did not stumble here because the text itself teaches by what the vessels DO.
findings.evidence: Text: “when the Father of Life was about to discharge these three vessels… He discharged them and cast them down to the earth.” This is a process description with state/sequence (“one by one at its hour and season”). Reading: “ordered descent… in ordered sequence.” No narrative break is reported.

findings.diagnosis: Mostly clean correspondential teaching with minor damage/compression. The ‘three garments’ and the clause about something remaining are functional (how the descent is mediated; why marks remain). The only ‘stumble’ is interpretive compression caused by dense metaphors plus lacunae, not an insertion.
findings.evidence: Text: “in these three garments, they of wind and of water and of fire… poured… into the three pits… something remained behind… their mark and type displayed.” Reading notes the same: “exact nuance… compresses multiple functions… (protection, accommodation, and mode of operation).” That is a normal difficulty of correspondential imagery, not a change to administrative voice.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential ‘residues’ section: each remnant is justified by observable function/behavior (salinity surrounds; darkness blocks light; volcanic fire and sterility). No administrative overlay. The only instability is textual damage and over-extended description in ¶6, which produces the reading’s ‘catalogue’ comment; removing it would remove the chapter’s key functional signature (sterility as effect of fire-remnant).
findings.evidence: Text (¶4): “remnant… in water is… salinity… inner sea that surrounds the worlds.” (functional boundary). Text (¶5): “black mountain… no sunlight… because the darkness… gushes… manifests above it.” (functional obstruction). Text (¶6): “fumes of fire gush up… barren places where no fruit sprouts…” Reading: “extended catalogue… some phrases appear textually damaged, but the spiritual drift… is consistent.” That is exactly “genuine difficulty: damaged text,” not an insertion signal (no named rulers, stations, ranks, etc.).

findings.diagnosis: Clean, tightly structured correspondential core: three-cycle purification narrative (water → darkness → fire) is entirely process-based (like draws like; separation; confinement). The repeated ‘Just as… so also…’ is a hallmark of correspondential exposition, not administrative ranking. The spiritual reading’s strongest coherence occurs here, confirming substrate integrity.
findings.evidence: Text (¶8): purpose stated functionally: “so that also the water and the darkness and the fire… would be drawn and ascend… and the earths would be purified.” Text (¶9-¶11): repeated mechanism: “Just as… so also…”; “was drawn… towards its kind”; “Fire was added to fire”; then “swept… shut… cast.” Reading: “chapter holds together strongly… most coherent where it repeats the three-cycle pattern.” No stumble and no foreign named bureaucracy.

findings.diagnosis: Mostly correspondential conclusion with one localized mixed-voice term. The ‘Porter’ functions as a regulator in the ascent mechanism, but the title is introduced without internal definition and can feel like a governance-title intruding into a functional wrap-up. This is not enough to excise: it is a single named role, not a territorial inventory; and it still serves the process logic (ascent ‘before’ a regulating threshold). Best treated as a minor administrative coloring/lexical overlay rather than a block insertion.
findings.evidence: Text: “these three powers… ascend before the Porter and traverse the earths.” Reading note: “The identity of the ‘one who admits and regulates influx’ is functionally clear, but the named title in the source has no further internal definition here.” That is precisely a ‘stumble’ of definition, not a narrative break. Removing “Porter” would not materially improve flow; it would only anonymize the threshold function already implied by “ascend… traverse.”
findings.scope: Annotate the clause “which ascend before the Porter” in ¶12 as a likely titular/terminological overlay (named gatekeeping role) inserted into an otherwise functional ascent-summary.

textual_criticism.summary: Findings: 5 total. Substrate is overwhelmingly correspondential and narratively coherent (¶2-¶11 clean). One genuine difficulty is text damage/over-extended phrasing in ¶6 (no excision warranted). One minor mixed-voice lexical intrusion occurs in ¶12 (“the Porter”), best handled by annotation of that clause. Recommendations: annotate 1 (localized); excise 0; none 4.

harmonized_paragraphs.text: As for what you have asked me about the vessels, you must understand this, that when the Father of Life was about to discharge these three vessels he poured the three upon this earth, one by one at its (appointed) hour and season. He discharged them and cast them down to the earth.

Then he bailed and scooped them from this earth in these three garments, they of wind and of water and of fire, which swathed his body. He poured and made them flow into the three pits [which]hich he had [es]tablished during the construc[tio]n of the worlds [and when he had shut them in,] they [yet] something remained behind on the face of the earth from these three vessels, so that you can find their mark and type displayed in the universe.
The element that is left in water is the pungency and the salinity of this salty inner sea that surrounds the worlds.

And the remnant that is left from the darkness is this black mountain that exists in the surroundings of the sunrise. For when the sun would shine over the world no sunlight is visible there, because the darkness that gushes from it manifests above it.

And the remnant that remains behind from the fire, upon the earth, are all the mountains and islands from where fumes of fire gush up and are visible. For these things are the remnant of the great vessel, the vestige that was conjoined with this fire that comes up from the earth; together with the mountains and hills [and valleys, and barren] places where no fruit sprouts on the trees [and stony] greater than that place from the limb and [the root of] the trees shall not bear fruit in that place.

Happen you know this! When the Father of Life discharged these vessels from above upon the earth, he poured them out for this reason: so that also the water and the darkness and the fire that exist in these three earths would be drawn and ascend towards they that had come down from above, and the earths would be purified and cleansed. Due to this he poured these vessels down to the earth, of water and of darkness and of fire, so that also the water and darkness and fire that exist in the earths would be drawn up towards they that had descended from above.

Now, first of all, he discharged the water, the waste, the poison of the rulers who are above. He cleansed the firmaments of the [water of darkness] he poured down the dark waters. [Just as the] waters fell from heaven to earth, so also the waters below in the earths were drawn and came up from below towards the waters that had come from above to the earths. The waters [were] purified of the dark poison that exists in them. Then he swept them outside and made them a great vessel and a wall of sea that surrounds the universe, and on which the ships sail.

After the water, he discharged the darkness. He purified the firmaments and dried from them the darkness with which they are weighed down. He discharged it down to the earth. Just as he had purified the firmaments, so also he purified the earths. The darkness that is in the earths was drawn up towards the darkness that had been discharged from above. He swept them both out and shut them in that [vessel] of darkness [beneath] the water.

And he discharged the fire from heaven to earth, [so that] that time again the fire that was shut [in] the earth below was drawn and came up towards its kind. Fire was added to fire. Afterwards, he swept it out and cast it into the outer underworld, which [he had constructed for] them outside the universe.

In the same way that he purified the firmaments above as a place for the light-givers to journey [and for the luminaries to go and come,] so also he purified the earths below and swept from them the fire and the darkness and the water [that were mixed in them.] He has purified them for the ascent of these three powers, they of the wind and the water and the fire, which ascend before the Porter and traverse the earths.

changes_summary: No text was excised or altered. The only targeted item in the findings was Finding 5 (¶12) with a recommendation to annotate the clause “which ascend before the Porter”; per rule, annotation does not modify the chapter text.
